title: Correct final speed
description: Essential: The answer must give the speed at point A as 5√2 m/s or equivalent numerical form.

title: Correct maximum distance
description: Essential: The answer must give the maximum distance up the incline as 5 m.

title: Work-energy on rough segment
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem from O to A, accounting for work done by F and friction.

title: Force work calculation
description: Important: The work done by the variable force F must be correctly computed from the area under the F-x graph.

title: Friction work
description: Important: The work done by kinetic friction on OA must be included with correct sign (negative).

title: Work-energy on incline
description: Important: The solution must apply work-energy from A to highest point on AB, considering only gravity.

title: Incline force resolution
description: Optional: Explicitly resolves gravity into component along incline for work calculation.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for work done by friction or gravity (e.g., positive friction work).

title: Graph area mistake
description: Pitfall: Miscalculates area under F-x graph (e.g., wrong triangle area or omits rectangle).

title: Units omission
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack proper units (m/s and m).
